title: M6.P2 E807/T39: doctrine: the reference documents
body:
Slice T39 of the renovation order: `docs/reviews/order.md` § T39, id `doctrine-reference` in `docs/reviews/slices.json`. Phase M6.P2, under the doctrine epic #807 (titled `E807/T39` and parented there before dispatch, `milestone-phase-naming.md`; T4 #651 complete and idle at `6ec78bbf8c`, awaiting the area's merge; T38 #685 accepted with 22/22 criteria, awaiting the area merge, its branch `feature/m6-doctrine-skills-685`). Proposed by the survey (#641); the order is D-WORKFLOW-188 (the fourth version, 2026-10-23). Run under the per-slice procedure of `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` § 6b, from the brief the planner writes before dispatch (§ 7).

## Scope

- **Area:** doctrine; **kind:** table; **lens:** cost against value
- **Why here:** the rest of the doctrine area: README, TRADEMARK, LICENSE and `licenses/`, `documentation/`, `plans/`, and the reference docs under `docs/` (upstream, releases, the rename, the menu map): tabled for what misleads a reader today
- **Paths:** areas `doctrine`; globs `(all)`; the rest of these areas. 254 paths; 38,598 lines by the inventory's column at its head `eb4763e3cc` (`GROUPS TOTAL 254 38598 groups 15`), and over the 223 text rows at the P1 tip `2174265e9c` 38,675 by `grep -c ''` and 38,674 by `wc -l` (one upstream licence text lacks its trailing newline), the 31 binary rows (1 gz, 2 pdf, 28 png) named and not counted -- the brief's ruling (h), both figures side by side; `190 lines read, 190 of them fork-own` is the inventory's *Read* rule (a path's lines count only when its language is in the tool's `CODE` set, and two rows qualify: `docs/pixelelated/art/source/generate.py`, python, 180, and `docs/pixelelated/art/source/wordmark.css`, css, 10 -- #809 owns the rendering), not the slice's size: a table slice reads every text row. The exact list is `tools/renovation-inventory --order`'s membership of `doctrine-reference`.
- **Provenance tiers:** fork-own 164, upstream-carried 90 (the 90 are `licenses/` 75 and `documentation/` 15, all byte-identical to the merge base `c445081a59`, 76 of them to `upstream/next` `651150fc88`; read-only here, their findings for #528 or the next upstream base merge). By the brief's ruling (a) the edit scope is the reference documents proper: the 254 less the 90 upstream-carried, less the ledger rows (the coordinator's twelve under `docs/reviews/`, the generated `docs/releases/catalog.md`, the tool inputs `docs/pr-series/map.txt` and `docs/releases/rc-accept.txt`, the running ledgers `docs/vm-qa-log.md` and `docs/cloud-sync-changelog.md`, the one plan under `plans/`, the 31 binaries), less `LICENSE.md` and `docs/upstream/` -- the class sizes are the stage-A `CARVE` lines, never a figure typed here (the brief's version 2 reads `edit-scope 68`, `edit-under-naming 1`, so 69 reference documents proper, with `docs/rasteratops/p0-sweep-hits.txt` in the ledger)
- **Read before:** none (the renovation gates no release, D-WORKFLOW-187)
- **Review depth:** Local -- a table
- **Interacting subsystems (read-only context):** every area (25 to 29 rules govern each, cross-reference.md)

reviewed-at: 86ebb6dffce7bec2dda6296bd84dd225a28b1347
fixed-at: 4eb5dfab8e745914a55e7de3e5a43c5b91ebc608

Can this be done on the VM? **No, for nearly all of it** -- the slice is a table of what the reference documents claim about the tree, the tools and the record, and reading a file at a hash is not a test, a proof or a measurement (`vm-first.md`; #807 `:19`'s answer for the area, R5 § D, C23). **The one exception** is a document that claims a guest behaviour -- a VM recipe, a tool's guest option, a frame a check reads, what a walk shows -- whose truth only a guest would show: it is checked first against the tool's options and source and `docs/vm-qa-log.md`, and **recorded as `[unverified]` in `02` with the proof a later slice could make**; this lane brings nothing to a guest (ruling (q)). A document that claims a handheld fact is read against `docs/releases/device-facts.md`, never tested on a handheld (R5 § D). Which of the 254 carry a guest claim was not read `[unverified]` (R5 § D; R3 § 6 found none in the paths and names it read); stage B's table finds them, each a `02` row. (The brief's § 5, in place of the generated *No test is proposed: a table slice is host analysis of the tree; a removal it proposes is proven on the GENERIC_X64 guest before it is a punch item.* line, as #685's was replaced at its dispatch.)

## Acceptance criteria

Review depth: Local -- a table (plan § 6c, D-WORKFLOW-184: `second-opinions/review-plan.json` with its `tier_exception` and no reviewer). Executor: Opus 5.5 at high effort unless the dispatch comment says otherwise. `reviewed-at:` and `fixed-at:` are written above by the executor at hand-back.

## Never run in this slice

**What never runs in this slice:** an image build, a package build or any
compiler; `config/options` sourced anywhere; a guest; a fetch -- no
`git fetch`, no `git ls-remote`, no `gh api` of another repository's contents
(the one `gh` read of another name is R2's redirect check,
`gh api repos/maxengel/rocknix`, which this lane need not repeat); a council
run, a Facilitator call, any `tools/council/run` call keyed or keyless, any
`scripts/council-*`, `scripts/verify-*` or `node` script, `npm install`;
`tools/release-catalog --write`, `tools/renovation-status` or
`tools/renovation-drift` writing a ledger, or any generator that writes a
ledger (`tools/work-log-index --write` after the lane's own log entry
excepted); `tools/pr-stack-check` (it makes a worktree);
`tools/rasteratops-identity-check` unless an edit reached `LICENSE.md`,
`TRADEMARK.md` or the wordmark, with its temporary directory under
`/workspace/tmp/m6-t39/`; a handheld; the owner's accounts or any hosted
account; M7's roots, worktrees or prep directories; a held directory
(D-WORKFLOW-215; `/workspace/tmp/m6-t34/held/`,
`/workspace/tmp/m6-t36/held/`); `~/.config/council/env`, anything under
`~/.ROCKNIX/` or `~/.rocknix/`, the wordlist
`~/.config/rocknix/forbidden-terms` (its tool alone reads it), the user-level
`~/.claude/`; a print of a credential-shaped line or of a variable's value (a
variable is named, never printed); `guard_load` (it sources the wordlist); an
